'''Chaney J. Johnson''' (born June 20, 2002) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Brooklyn Nets]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA), on a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Long Island Nets]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[UAH Chargers]] and [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn Tigers]].

==College career==
Holding no offers from power programs coming out of [[Thompson High School]] in [[Alabaster, Alabama]], Johnson began his collegiate career with the Division II [[UAH Chargers|University of Alabama, Huntsville]] in 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Calling God: Chaney Johnson's excellence stems from strong faith and a will to win|url=https://www.shelbycountyreporter.com/sports/calling-god-chaney-johnsons-excellence-stems-from-strong-faith-and-a-will-to-win-626431|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=shelbycountyreporter.com|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Nets sign Chaney Johnson, Cavs G Leaguer, to third two-way|url=https://www.netsdaily.com/longislandnets/103612/nets-sign-chaney-johnson-cavs-g-leager-to-third-two-way|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=netsdaily.com|language=en}}</ref> During the 2022–23 season, he averaged 15.9 points and 6.6 rebounds, leading the team to a 27–8 record and regular-season championship title.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Talented Transfer Guard Johnson To Make Immediate Impact|url=https://auburntigers.com/news/2023/04/21/talented-transfer-guard-johnson-to-make-immediate-impact|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=auburntigers.com|language=en}}</ref> Johnson was named the [[Gulf South Conference]] Player of the Year for the season.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Brooklyn Nets sign Alabama high school, UAH, Auburn alumnus|url=https://www.al.com/sports/2025/12/brooklyn-nets-sign-alabama-high-school-uah-auburn-alumnus.html?outputType=amp|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=al.com|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Chaney Johnson Named GSC Player of the Year|url=https://uahchargers.com/news/2023/2/28/mens-basketball-chaney-johnson-named-gsc-player-of-the-year.aspx|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=uahchargers.com|language=en}}</ref>

On April 21, 2023, Johnson transferred to [[Auburn Tigers men's basketball|Auburn]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=From D-II to Elite Eight, Chaney Johnson living March dreams with Auburn|url=https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/college/michigan-state-university/2025/03/29/from-d-ii-to-elite-eight-chaney-johnson-lives-march-dream-with-auburn/82722369007/?gnt-cfr=1&gca-cat=p&gca-uir=false&gca-epti=undefined&gca-ft=0&gca-ds=sophi|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=detroitnews.com|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Auburn basketball adds UAH transfer Chaney Johnson|url=https://www.al.com/auburnbasketball/2023/04/uah-transfer-chaney-johnson-commits-to-auburn.html|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=al.com|language=en}}</ref> In the 2023–24 season, he averaged 4.7 points, 3.4 rebounds, and 0.8 assists across 35 appearances (two starts).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Chaney Johnson 2023-24 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/5174655/type/mens-college-basketball/year/2024|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=espn.com|language=en}}</ref> During the 2024–25 campaign, his final collegiate season, Johnson averaged 9.1 points and 4.9 rebounds, helping Auburn make a run to the [[NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament#Final Four|Final Four]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Former Auburn forward Chaney Johnson signs two-way deal with Nets|url=https://auburnwire.usatoday.com/story/sports/college/auburn/mens-basketball/2025/12/27/auburn-basketball-brooklyn-nets-chaney-johnson-two-way-deal/87928317007/|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=auburnwire.usatoday.com|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Chaney Johnson 2024-25 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/5174655/type/mens-college-basketball/year/2025|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=espn.com|language=en}}</ref>

==Professional career==
===Cleveland Charge (2025)===
After going unselected in the [[2025 NBA draft]], Johnson signed an [[Exhibit 10]] contract with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] on June 27, 2025.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Auburn basketball's Chaney Johnson inks Exhibit 10 contract with Cleveland Cavaliers|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/article/auburn-basketballs-chaney-johnson-inks-154448966.html|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=sports.yahoo.com|language=en}}</ref> He was waived prior to the start of the regular season on October 14.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Chaney Johnson: Waived by Cavaliers|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/chaney-johnson-waived-by-cavaliers/|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=cbssports.com|language=en}}</ref> Johnson subsequently joined the [[Cleveland Charge]] of the [[NBA G League]], where he averaged 12.8 points, 5.4 rebounds, 1.9 assists, 1.4 steals, and 1.1 blocks across 16 appearances (10 starts).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Brooklyn Nets Sign Chaney Johnson|url=https://www.nba.com/nets/news/brooklyn-nets-sign-chaney-johnson|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=nba.com|language=en}}</ref>

===Brooklyn / Long Island Nets (2025–present)===
On December 26, 2025, Johnson signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Brooklyn Nets]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Former Auburn forward Chaney Johnson signs two-way deal with Nets|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/former-auburn-forward-chaney-johnson-200026238.html|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=sports.yahoo.com|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Former Auburn Forward Signs Deal With Brooklyn Nets|url=https://www.si.com/college/auburn/basketball/former-auburn-forward-signs-deal-with-brooklyn-nets|access-date=December 28, 2025|website=si.com|language=en}}</ref> Johnson made 17 appearances (including one start) for the Nets during the [[2025–26 NBA season]], recording averages of 8.2 points, 4.6 rebounds, and 2.1 assists.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Chaney Johnson 2025-26 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/5174655/chaney-johnson|access-date=August 3, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}}</ref>
